## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. It starts at Bluewaters Mall, Bluewaters Island - Dubai.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Get close to your favorite celebrities and take selfies with 60 wax figures, including 16 new ones from the Middle East. See the stars in six themed zones: Leaders and Royals, Fashion, Film, Bollywood, Sport, and the A-List Music Party.
>
> Check out the Wax Hand experience at Madame Tussauds Dubai. Create a wax model of your own hand and decorate it as a souvenir to take home. The process is simple and safe.
>
> Take home a unique memento from your visit to Madame Tussauds Dubai.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €47.62. It was rated 5.0 out of 5 from 2 ratings. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
